The Approximate Number Generation chart includes three segments: Approximate Quantities (45.03%, beige), Comparative Relationships (36.26%, light blue), and Absolute Absence (18.71%, light purple), arranged clockwise from the top-right. The Disjunctive & Conjunctive chart consists of two segments: Disjunctive (49.51%, light blue) and Conjunctive (50.49%, light pink), split nearly evenly with Conjunctive slightly larger, positioned on the right and left halves respectively. Each chart includes percentage labels inside the slices, and no legend is present. The segments are arranged in a visually descending order by size in the first two charts, while the third chart is split vertically.
